aliasing_rules: Nested field extents are contained in their complete aggregate, not added as new allocations.
Same owned payload moved between places does not prove physical slot overlap or new allocation.
Alternative enum arms are not summed; call/return and cleanup overlaps require evidence.
Shared backing is charged once to its complete live ownership set through final destruction; borrowed views retain distinct representation only.
Unknown backing capacities or live regions refuse admission, never default to zero.
arithmetic: Use checked finite integer byte arithmetic; account for full selected storage-region capacity/alignment/padding. Work units/prices remain independently selected later.
events: scope pair produced and original acquisition charge sticky
attempt/fixture move into actual closure; expected remains borrowed
dispatch call and complete admitted child return
shared inspection while complete child remains live
complete child destruction/cleanup and child-only token returned to separately provisioned P0
child-only release; original acquisition charge remains retained
next_slice: Bind the dispatch closure, complete returned child and destruction boundary to explicit physical storage regions and normal/refusal/unwind live intervals; retain all unobserved callee/parent/token and carried backing inputs. This is a representation/lifetime contract before a charge selection.

numeric_leaves.use: single actual dispatch closure representation only
single complete returned child owner representation only
single complete scope pair representation only

storage_expression: B_peak >= max_t(bytes(union of proven live physical inline regions at t) + unique separately retained backing capacities at t + independently provisioned parent/token regions). No numeric bound until every term and overlap is established.
